Hi everyone,

The Zendesk upgrade is scheduled for Saturday, November 14, from 06:00 to 10:00 Pacific. Agents will not be able to log in during that window, and customers will see a maintenance banner on the help center.

After the upgrade, macros and views will look the same, but the ticket sidebar moves to the right. Anika Desai has recorded a three-minute walkthrough, which you can find in the #support channel on Slack.

Thanks,
Owen
